title: Count Vowels in a String
question: Read a line of text and count its vowels (a, e, i, o, u), ignoring case.
code:
text = input("Text: ")
vowels = "aeiou"
count = sum(1 for character in text.lower() if character in vowels)
print("Vowels:", count)
expected_output:
For input Hello World:
Text: Hello World
Vowels: 3
explanation: Convert the text to lowercase, then count characters that occur in the vowel string.
